info.name: KHR_AREA_LIGHTS
info.comment: Local copy of the ANARI registry extension. Parameter set is unmodified (all of it is implemented); only the dependency stems are rewritten to the local trimmed copies (cycles_khr_light_ring, cycles_khr_light_quad) so the code generator does not pull the untrimmed registry files back in, plus khr_light_spot which the registry copy defines an object for but omits from its dependency list. Semantics notes: point 'radiance' with radius 0 and directional 'radiance' with angularDiameter 0 degenerate to intensity/irradiance respectively (warned); hdri 'visible'=false shows the renderer 'background' color to camera rays.

parameters.name: angularDiameter
parameters.description: apparent size of the light in radians

parameters.name: radiance
parameters.description: the amount of light emitted by a point on the light source in a direction in W/sr/m^2
